This video is part of the supplementary material of the paper titled "Learning Action-Conditional and Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting World Models for Rigid Objects" by Jens U. Kreber, Lukas Mack and Joerg Stueckler. The paper has been uploaded to arxiv.org on June 1, 2026 and is available at https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01950 .
